title: An Empirical Study of Reinforcement Learning Scaling Laws
abstract: arXiv:2610.33420v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The discovery of scaling laws enables prediction of the performance, the optimal resource allocation strategy, and the best hyperparameter configuration of a large-scale training job based on inexpensive experiments at smaller scales. Guided by these empirical scaling laws, the deep learning community has achieved great success in training large (self-)supervised models on Internet-scale datasets. In contrast, despite its potential and wide application, reinforcement learning (RL) has yet to find a guiding principle for predictable scaling. In this work, we conduct an empirical study of RL scaling laws of an actor-critic algorithm in two procedurally generated environments, Starpilot and Craftax. We discover empirical scaling laws with strong predictive performance in both environments. The discovered scaling laws accurately predict the aforementioned three quantities for larger-scale training jobs up to two orders of magnitude in total

translated_title: 强化学习缩放定律的实证研究
translated_abstract: 缩放定律的发现使得人们能够基于小规模下的低成本实验，预测大规模训练任务的性能、最优资源分配策略以及最佳超参数配置。在这些经验缩放定律的指导下，深度学习社区在互联网规模数据集上训练大型（自）监督模型方面取得了巨大成功。相比之下，尽管强化学习（RL）具有巨大潜力和广泛应用，却尚未找到可预测扩展的指导原则。在这项工作中，我们对actor-critic算法在两个程序化生成环境Starpilot和Craftax中的强化学习缩放定律进行了实证研究。我们在两个环境中都发现了具有强预测性能的经验缩放定律。所发现的缩放定律能够准确预测总计算规模跨越两个数量级的大规模训练任务的上述三个量。
tldr: 该研究首次在强化学习领域发现可靠的经验缩放定律，能够基于小规模实验准确预测大规模训练任务的性能、最优资源分配策略和最佳超参数配置。
en_tdlr: This work discovers empirical RL scaling laws that accurately predict the performance, optimal resource allocation, and best hyperparameter configurations of large-scale actor-critic training up to two orders of magnitude in compute, based on inexpensive small-scale experiments.
